fusions.name: Rouse the Herd
fusions.desc: A bite at an enemy up to 6 tiles away that deals 28 poison damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. When it hits, every ally near you deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Strike From Among Them
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 2.5 tiles of you takes 7 poison damage. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you, up to 32%. Holds 3 charges; each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Hidden in the Herd
fusions.desc: Veils you and your nearby allies for 6 seconds, moving 10% faster. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Borrowed Body Heat
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
